parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The instance ID of Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA).

parameters.name: AccessLogRecordCustomizedHeaderList
parameters.description: A list of custom header field names to be included in access logs.

parameters.name: AccessLogRecordCustomizedHeadersEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include custom headers in access logs. Valid values:

- **true**: Yes.
- **false** (default): No.

> You can set this parameter to **true** only when the **AccessLogEnabled** toggle for the instance is turned on.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint group.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. The only valid value is cn-hangzhou.

parameters.name: SlsProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the Data Service Project.
